Finance login → /partnerships accessible with add-partnership-btn visible.

issues: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) height(-1)' logged when chart container renders before layout resolves — cosmetic, chart still renders correctly after.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_employees.py profile edit: employee self-edit correctly strips 'name' key (only admin renames) — verified.

routes_employees.py duplicate-assign check uses find_one on {user_id, course_id} before insert — race-safe enough for admin-driven single-writer scenario; could add unique compound index for stronger guarantee.
routes_logs.py _build_query date_to boundary: appends T23:59:59.999999+00:00 only when len==10, which is correct for YYYY-MM-DD; other lengths pass through verbatim — good.
routes_logs.py manual purge logs a 'logs_purged' entry AFTER deletion so it survives the purge itself — correct ordering.
scheduler.py purge job with 90-day retention and purge_runs record is well-structured; seed_flags guard on aged seed logs prevents re-seed after purge — matches intended one-shot behaviour.
Locations map response uses hardcoded CITY_COORDS with clients/branches/employees grouped per city; totals match seed exactly (11/2/8/8) — clean.
Partnerships stats derivation (unused_benefits_value / renewing_soon list / annual_cost) is server-computed and matches seed exactly; toggle roundtrip is idempotent.
All Phase 4 pages expose data-testid for stats, cards, forms, dialogs, and pagination controls — excellent testability.
Employee dashboard triggers Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first mount; add minHeight/minWidth to ResponsiveContainer parent to silence (non-blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Phase 4 testids verified across admin, employee, finance flows)

seed_data_creation: Test created 1 TEST_Partnership (POST→PUT→DELETE, fully cleaned up). Toggled benefit bn-01a twice (net-neutral, restored to unused=₹1,85,000). Assigned a spare course to user-employee, drove progress to 100, then DELETEd assignment. Manual log purge executed as final backend test — deleted the 10 aged seed logs (seed-oldlog-01..10) which are NOT re-seeded by design (seed_flags guard). Recent seed-oldlog-11..13 remain in DB. No production/seed records altered other than the aged logs (intended one-shot purge per PRD).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Aged seed logs seed-oldlog-01..10 have already been consumed by this iteration's manual purge test (seed_flags 'phase4_old_logs' blocks re-seed by design). Any future purge test will therefore return deleted_count=0 unless new aged logs are inserted manually or seed_flags entry is cleared. All 4 phase pytest files coexist and can be run together: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (~98 tests). partnership toggle test is idempotent — safe to rerun. TEST_UI leads from iteration 3 may still exist; they slightly inflate CEO pipeline value but do not affect Phase 4 assertions.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Only cosmetic finding: Recharts warns width/height(-1) on employee dashboard first paint — ResponsiveContainer initializes before flex layout resolves. Fix: wrap in a div with explicit min-height (e.g. h-64) or set aspect ratio.
